title: Tail bound for blocked restricted gate width
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates, let $g$ be an AND or OR gate, and let $k$ be a natural number. Choose a subset $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ by including each coordinate independently with probability $1/2$, then choose uniformly a sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$. Form the restriction that leaves $J$ free and fixes the other coordinates according to $z$. The probability that the restricted gate width of $T$, divided by $5$ and rounded down, is at least $k$ is at most $(1/4)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates
$g$ is an AND or OR gate
